entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yes! We're here! Hawaiiiiiiii!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...I am SO embarrassed.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Is this the smell of Hawaii?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Actually, I've been wonderin' since[n]the airport, but what is this smell?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Supposedly the lingering scent of carpet[n]cleaner. It's coconut-scented.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Plus, I'd say the scent of plumeria for[n]the leis are amplifying the tropical[n]atmosphere here.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What are you, the king of random facts!?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'm the type that likes to look up stuff[n]beforehand.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Then tell me a cheap but good place[n]to eat.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Do that after we've figured out room[n]assignments. We can't go out until[n]we get our keys!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I wanna room with this guy.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: You belong to a different class,[n]Sakamoto-kun.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I can't?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It complicates roll call.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Everyone butts you out, after all.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I bet there aren't many people who'd be[n]okay rooming with you.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Shuddup, we both stick out like a sore[n]thumb, you know.

entries.speaker: Tall Student
entries.en: Takamaki-san, have you decided on[n]which room to stay in?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No, not yet.

entries.speaker: Tall Student
entries.en: In that case, how about rooming with me?

entries.speaker: Bespectacled Student
entries.en: And if it's okay with you, do you want to[n]walk around together once we're free to[n]go about?

entries.speaker: Bespectacled Student
entries.en: We've never gone overseas before, so[n]we thought it'd be reassuring if we had[n]someone who knows English.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, sure, of course!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, see you guys later.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: C'mon, can you just hurry up and make[n]your decision?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Then, is it okay if I room with you?
That's fine.
I'd rather be alone...
Why are you asking?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: It's decided then.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Sheesh... This is too much trouble,[n]so you're rooming with Mishima-kun.[n]Period.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey... are you playing for the other[n]team?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: What're you talking about!?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Sheesh... This is too much of a hassle,[n]so you're rooming with Mishima-kun.[n]Period.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Anyway, don't do anything stupid, okay?[n]This isn't Japan, you know.
